summary: Iteration 3 (auth + multi-user): 61/61 backend tests pass. Added /app/backend/tests/test_auth_iter3.py (14 tests: register success/duplicate/validation, login OK/wrong/unknown, /me, protected endpoints reject anonymous, invalid token rejected, two-user data isolation for settings+treatments incl. B DELETE A's treatment -> 404, fresh user POST /api/sync backfills demo so /api/status returns a demo reading). Updated existing fixtures in test_xdrip_api.py and test_xdrip_iter2.py to register-or-login demo_user and attach Bearer token for all legacy tests (46 legacy tests still green with per-user scope). Fixed one legacy test (test_post_summary_streams was using a bare requests.post without auth header). Frontend (390x844, Expo web): App opens on sign-in screen with all documented testIDs present (auth-username-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, auth-switch-mode, auth-confirm-input, auth-error). Wrong password shows auth-error 'Wrong username or password'. Switching to register + creating a throwaway TEST_fe_* account lands on Home. Initial Home briefly shows 'No readings yet. Pick a data source in Settings.' for a fresh user because the per-user demo backfill is only triggered by POST /api/sync (or the 60s background loop); tapping the 'Sync now' button on Settings or waiting up to one minute populates Home with a live glucose value (observed 115 mg/dL, 246 readings, 3h chart rendered with blue dots). Settings tab shows account-username ('Signed in as TEST_fe_...') and account-signout-button. Reload keeps the user signed in (token in secure storage). Sign out returns to the login screen. Chart tooltip dots render once readings exist. Deprecated-packages note: expo-router/unstable-native-tabs still used in (tabs)/_layout.tsx (carried over from iter2).

integration_issues.issue: Home shows 'No readings yet. Pick a data source in Settings.' immediately after register because the demo backfill only runs on POST /api/sync (or the per-user 60s loop). The problem statement allows 'may need ~5-10s for first sync; pull-to-refresh or wait' and tapping Sync now in Settings populates Home immediately. Minor UX nit: consider calling /api/sync automatically right after signIn() in src/auth.tsx so first-time users see glucose within a second.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated: `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is still being used. Switch to `expo-router/native-tabs`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx (carried from iter2 - not addressed yet).

action_items: Optional UX: trigger an initial POST /api/sync right after signIn() so brand-new users see glucose on Home in under a second (currently requires tapping 'Sync now' or waiting up to 60s for the background loop).
Non-blocking: migrate `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` import to `expo-router/native-tabs` (carried over from iter2).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py login(): request.client may be None when FastAPI runs behind an unknown proxy; the code already handles that ('x'). Good. Consider also keying brute-force by X-Forwarded-For when present so one shared office IP doesn't lock a victim user as easily.

auth.py register(): duplicate detection relies on 'duplicate' appearing in the exception string. Prefer catching pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError explicitly (same import style already used in server.py).
server.py sync_loop: iterates db.users.find() with no projection order guarantee - for large user counts, consider batching and skipping users with s.source == 'manual' to avoid pointless work.

server.py: /api/auth router has no dependency on current_user (correct), but /api/auth/me reads the user via Depends(current_user). Confirm OpenAPI schema does not accidentally require auth on register/login (verified via 401s only on non-auth /api/*).
LoginScreen.tsx: setMode + setError are called in a comma expression inside Pressable onPress - works but slightly unusual; prefer an explicit block for readability.

auth.tsx module-level `let token` is shared across tabs/windows via storage on reload only. If two tabs are open and one signs out, the other keeps its in-memory token until next reload; fine for mobile but worth noting for the web preview.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of auth flows verified on Expo web preview

seed_data_creation: Only transient TEST_* users created during tests (TEST_reg_*, TEST_dup_*, TEST_login_*, TEST_iso_a_*, TEST_iso_b_*, TEST_sync_*, TEST_fe_*). demo_user is created once (idempotent register) and used as the long-lived session for the legacy pytest suites - its data is restored to defaults by the existing TestZCleanup and TestZZRestore tests (source=demo, unit=mgdl, em_contacts=[], glucose_alarms=[], reminders=[], alarm_sounds={}, em_enabled=false, target_low=70, target_high=180, sensor_started_at=null).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three backend regression suites under /app/backend/tests/: test_xdrip_api.py (27 iter1 core, auth fixture now logs in demo_user), test_xdrip_iter2.py (18 iter2 features, auth fixture now logs in demo_user), test_auth_iter3.py (16 iter3 auth + isolation + fresh-user sync). Full run: `pytest backend/tests/ --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results_iter3.xml` ~16s, 61/61 pass. Important: the module-scoped `api` fixtures reuse demo_user's bearer token - DO NOT call wrong-password tests against demo_user in future iterations because the login_attempts collection locks that IP+username combo for 15 min after 5 failures. test_auth_iter3.py uses random TEST_* usernames to avoid this. Frontend auth testIDs confirmed working: auth-username-input, auth-password-input, auth-confirm-input, auth-submit-button, auth-switch-mode, auth-error, account-username, account-signout-button. Tab labels (no testID) are 'Home', 'History', 'Stats', 'Settings' - use text selectors. Session persistence verified across page reload.
rca_of_issue: No bugs. One expected-behaviour nit: brand-new users see 'No readings yet' on Home for a few seconds because the demo backfill only runs when a sync is triggered (POST /api/sync or the 60s background loop). The problem statement explicitly allows this ('may need ~5-10s for first sync; pull-to-refresh or wait') and tapping 'Sync now' in Settings or waiting <=60s surfaces a full chart. An optional one-liner in src/auth.tsx signIn() to call api('/sync', {method:'POST'}) would smooth this over.
